title: automate-audit-sink-rotation-and-secrets-sync-for-private-deployments
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Private (VPC/on-prem) customers require automated, auditable rotation of export sink credentials and deterministic synchronization of KMS/secret references between the Private installer and the audit-log-exporter Helm chart. This PR wires a coordinated automation flow across Terraform modules, Helm values, and installer hooks to ensure audit sinks are rotated on schedule, secrets are synced to the cluster via the installer, and exports continue without downtime.

What I changed: 1) Terraform: added a new module 'audit_sink_rotation' which provisions an external rotation schedule resource (Cloud/Rotor-compatible) and a ConfigMap with rotation policy metadata for customers running in VPC mode; 2) Helm chart: introduced values.private.sinkRotation and a new template for a Kubernetes CronJob that triggers rotation and posts to the audit-exporter control endpoint; 3) Installer hooks: new pre-upgrade and post-upgrade hooks in redwood-private-installer to seed rotated secrets and reconcile Vault/KMS mappings; 4) Secrets sync tooling: added scripts/installer/sync-secrets.sh and a controller-lite job to reconcile Secret objects from the installer-managed store; 5) Observability: added Prometheus metrics (audit_sink_rotation_success_total, audit_sink_rotation_failure_total) and alert rule examples for SRE; 6) Tests: e2e integration test that simulates rotation and verifies no packet loss to sinks and that retention policies remain intact.

Rollback/upgrade plan: Default rollout is canary (5% of nodes in Dedicated and single-namespace in Private). The installer adds a feature-flag 'enableSinkRotation'. Turning this off removes the CronJob and controller job; secrets remain untouched for manual rollback. Upgrade notes in CHANGELOG outline a safe path.

Migration/modes: For customers using external KMS (AWS, GCP, Vault), the terraform module emits a 'rotation-binding' resource and the installer hook will map the rotation token into the cluster Secret once. For air-gapped installs, a documented manual rotate path is included (scripts/rotate-sinks.sh) and the Helm chart allows disabling CronJob.

Security considerations: rotation tokens are never written to logs, controller uses RBAC least-privilege, secrets synced via installer are marked immutable when possible. We added a short audit trail for rotation operations to satisfy compliance teams.

Testing done: unit tests for terraform plan output, helm template rendering, integration tests in tests/e2e that run a fake sink and validate no dropped events during rotation, and a dry-run installer test running in CI.

Notes for reviewers: See README in the helmchart and terraform module for parameterization. This PR touches installer lifecycle and should be validated by platform/installer owners before rollout.
commits: feat(terraform): add audit_sink_rotation module with schedule and policy metadata
feat(helm): add sink-rotation CronJob template and values.private.sinkRotation
chore(installer): installer hooks to seed rotated secrets (pre/post upgrade)
feat(secrets): add sync-secrets.sh and controller-lite job to reconcile installer secrets
test(e2e): add audit_sink_rotation_test.go that simulates sink rotation
docs: document manual rotation and migration steps in docs/private-rotation.md
ci(ci): add terraform plan/unit checks for new module and e2e job into canary pipeline
review_comments: Ellen Wu (2026-02-22): Can we avoid writing rotation tokens into ConfigMaps? Suggest using sealed secrets or referencing existing KMS principal. Response: tokens are written only to a transient installer-only Secret and then deleted; updated docs to call this out.

Priya Shah (2026-02-23): The CronJob schedule defaults to daily; can we make it configurable per-customer and add a backoff policy? Response: made schedule configurable via values.private.sinkRotation.schedule and added retry/backoff annotations on the job.

Liam O'Connor (2026-02-25): e2e test flaky on CI due to timing. Suggest adding a deterministic fake-sink server with handshake semantics. Response: added a deterministic fake sink in tests and extended timeout assertions; CI run passed afterwards.
Ellen Wu (2026-03-01): Approved after small nits addressed.
Platform WG (2026-03-03): Noted that installer hook changes require an upgrade in private-installer >= v1.12.0. Author added compatibility matrix to docs.
ci_checks: ci/helm-lint: fail (templating lint on values-private.yaml) -> fixed in subsequent commit
release_notes:
- Private: automated audit sink rotation for VPC/on-prem installs (new Helm values and Terraform module).
- Installer: hooks to seed rotated secrets into the cluster; feature-flag 'enableSinkRotation' controls rollout.
- Observability: Prometheus metrics and example alerts for rotation success/failure.
- Migration notes: see docs/private-rotation.md for KMS mapping and manual rotation procedures.
notes: This PR coordinates across terraform, helm, and installer repos. The installer-side hooks are backward-compatible if the feature-flag is off. Reach out to @platform-team for rollout scheduling.
